title: SORTENTSTABLE projection scratch seed-copy elimination
scope: Avoid transiently copying source SORTENTSTABLE handle vectors that are immediately cleared before projected vectors are generated.
Preserve typed-table metadata, source immutability, output mapping, and existing pair-count limits.

sourceChange.before: Copy DRW_SortEntsTable including m_entityHandles and m_sortHandles, clear those arrays, reserve and fill projection arrays.
sourceChange.after: Default-construct output, copy the DRW_TableEntry base, copy m_blockOwnerHandle, then reserve and fill only projected arrays.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one avoidable transient copy of both source-sized handle vectors from the projection peak. Existing output arrays and writer-side remapping scratch remain bounded by their current limits and are not otherwise changed.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one avoidable typed SORTENTSTABLE projection copy without changing limits, output semantics, public APIs, peer cadence, or support claims. Broader 7S.2c scratch and retained-owner accounting remains open.

testsRun: Focused existing SORTENTSTABLE adapter round-trip CTest
method.limitations: The change removes the immediate source pair-vector deep copy but does not measure allocator overhead or process RSS and does not account every writer-side scratch structure. It preserves the existing bounded pair admission and is not a whole-process memory-bound claim.
